question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is: **extinct**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **'Extinct' **means having no living members (विलुप्त).

 
 
• **Example: **Dinosaurs are extinct animals that lived millions of years ago.
